_comment: Operational settings — PROTOCOL.md §4.2. NOT frozen, NOT part of the git tag, and safe to change mid-window: nothing here can change or steer the outcome. Optional in every sense: the file may be absent, and any key left out falls back to the default in server/runtime.js. Copy to runtime.json only if you need to change something. Pantheon admin credentials do NOT live here — they are environment variables (deploy/README.md §2).

pantheon._frey_public_url: Where the BROWSER should reach Frey, if that is not frey_base_url. The backend calls Frey from the server, where localhost is correct; the browser calls it too (PANTHEON-INTEGRATION.md §2) from a device on which localhost is that device. Leave it out when frey_base_url is publicly resolvable. Whatever ends up here must also appear in the proxy's CSP connect-src.

server._trust_proxy: Set true once a reverse proxy sets X-Forwarded-For. Behind one, every request arrives from 127.0.0.1 and rate_limit_per_minute becomes a single allowance shared by all twelve players. Left false, the header is ignored entirely — believing it with nothing in front lets any caller invent an address and collect an allowance per address.
